description: Unpaid lint of an x402 endpoint: fetches the 402 (GET and POST), then checks the challenge (version, accepts[] fields, CAIP-2 network, payTo/asset/amount sanity, EIP-712 name/version, timeouts, resource), transport (redirects, cache headers, CORS) and discovery files. Returns findings with ids, severities and fixes. Never pays. Free.
name: lint_x402_endpoint
